services.name: Manatee Cove
services.desc: Watch manatees underwater 24/7 on our live webcam! These majestic animals are “patients” at ZooTampa’s David A. Straz, Jr. Critical Care Center, the largest nonprofit manatee critical care center in the world. For more than 30 years, ZooTampa has been at the forefront of saving this iconic Florida species with more than 630 sick, injured, and orphaned manatees rescued and the majority successfully rehabilitated and triumphantly returned to their native waters.
